title: Leaving Chicago and playing alongside Sidney Bechet
summary: Duhé recalls how long he stayed in Chicago and his two-clarinet arrangement with Bechet, who played the hot parts.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
